mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message WHERE ((sender_id = #{userId1} AND receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND receiver_id = #{userId1})) AND NOT ((sender_id = #{userId1} AND is_deleted_by_sender = 1) OR (receiver_id = #{userId1} AND is_deleted_by_receiver = 1)) ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 AND is_deleted_by_receiver = 0

SELECT m1.* FROM message m1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id) as user1, GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id) as user2, MAX(create_time) as max_time FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND NOT ((sender_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted_by_sender = 1) OR (receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted_by_receiver = 1)) GROUP BY LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id), GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id) ) m2 ON LEAST(m1.sender_id, m1.receiver_id) = m2.user1 AND GREATEST(m1.sender_id, m1.receiver_id) = m2.user2 AND m1.create_time = m2.max_time ORDER BY m1.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
